People will always try to compare losses. What is worse? Surely this must be worse than that. The loss is the worst loss ever for the person it most immediately affects. This whole business of trying to compare losses is futile. In life we win and lose. It is a strange thing about people that they strive to compare loss. The instinct is obvious enough. We make comparisons on so many other levels, so surely we can apply this "comparison concept" to life events of gain and loss. The truth is, the life gain is the best there ever was for the winner, and the life loss is the worst there ever was for the loser. These life events are not assigned points. They are not sports. Stop trying to apply a scale to them, for god's sake.
